$Comment: The Horseman's Head, flown off his shoulders mid-fight: a Variant of Template_Flying_Aggressive carrying the game's Incandescent skull's own Modify, with its look, its health and a small lantern bomb (Root_Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Head_Bomb) in place of the skull's spores. While it flies, the Horseman's body cannot be hurt; killing it is how players break that, which the fight's script watches for. It only exists inside his fight. Never burning (_CombatConfig), DropList Empty. Any key the template does not declare makes the game refuse the whole role.
